rapport_notes: Genuine, reciprocated warmth — the customer spontaneously complimented her service ('been very nice... great customer skills'), and she celebrated small personal details like the daughter getting her own room.

coaching_note: Never explicitly asked for the close ('would you like our help with your move?') — she announced the booking rather than asking, missing the chance to get an active yes from the customer.
